explication: Google Ads MCP Server lets an LLM discover Google Ads customers and metadata, construct GAQL searches, and retrieve account results through MCP. The runtime starts in `server.py`, uses the shared coordinator to mount configurable tools, and delegates tool calls to the Google Ads API. Separate MCP resources expose discovery, metrics, segments, and release notes from Google documentation. OAuth mode adds Google authentication and configurable encrypted state storage. Some tool/resource wiring is inferred from explicit registration and README documentation; unsampled helpers are not expanded.
